HomePlace.SourceString: 异象管理局禁制机动队四队

Introduction.SourceString: 危险又迷人的E.T.D成员，代表局长令人捉摸不定的择人标准。
Introduction.LocalizedString: A dangerous yet captivating ETD member who represents the director's unpredictable hiring standards.

Content.SourceString:
异象管理局E.T.D四队的成员之一曾经是个罪犯。
至于她犯了什么罪才会被丢到那个传说中的格赫罗斯岛——也没什么大不了，只是无意之举让某些人睡了个醒不来的觉。
「无尽的新生与轮回，终归于黑洞般的虚无。」
手指轻轻绕着发梢，她弯起眉眼咯吱咯吱地笑了起来。
「我只是顺从他们的意愿，将那群狂欢之人带往他们穷尽一生所渴求的乐园罢了。」

作为特赦犯人，四队的成员们对待她与对常人一样，并无区分。
除了某只狗头人看似面色无常，眼神却藏着警惕。或许是因为几个月前双方的关系还是押送员与通缉犯吧？
嗯~总体而言，她觉得自己的新工作不错。尽情地战斗，让危险促进头脑的兴奋、疼痛刺激身体的颤栗……暴力正源于生命「过剩」的奢侈耗费，如何不叫人迷恋品尝呢？
虽然不知道那个奇怪的女人将她从岛上带出来的目的是什么——无所谓，反正她也无处可去。那个她曾虔诚地跪拜祈愿，将信仰热切托付的地方早已被拉上了封锁线，任谁见了那荒废的颓状都得笑出声来！唯独有一双熟悉的银质双目仍凝望着她，仁慈、宽厚、充满欲望——她能感受到。

「去大闹一场吧。法帝娅，我相信你会发现一些有意思的事。」
装货、狗和小屁孩？
法帝娅一如既往地眯起双眼。
那就……期待一下他们会给自己带来什么愉快的体验吧。
Content.LocalizedString:
One of the Bureau of Anomaly Control's ETD-4 members, and once a criminal.
As for what crime got her thrown onto the legendary Ghroth Island… nothing too serious. It was just an innocent little gesture that put some people to sleep forever.
"Endless rebirth and reincarnation all lead back to the black hole of nothingness."
Twirling her hair around her finger, she smiled with sparkling eyes.
"I simply followed their wishes, sending those party people to the paradise they'd been craving their whole lives."

As a pardoned prisoner, she isn't treated any differently than any other Squad 4 member.
Except by that dog-faced guy with calm but wary eyes. Maybe because a few months ago they were escort officer and wanted criminal?
Well, overall, she thinks her new job is pretty good. Fighting to her heart's content, letting danger excite her mind, letting pain make her body tremble… violence comes from life's excess. How could anyone not be addicted to tasting it?
She doesn't know why that strange woman brought her back from the island, but whatever. She had nowhere else to go anyway. The place where she once knelt and prayed devoutly, entrusting her faith, has long been sealed off. Anyone who sees that ruined wasteland would laugh! Only a pair of familiar silver eyes still gaze at her, merciful, generous, full of desire… she can feel it.

"Go raise some hell, Fadia. I'm sure you'll find something interesting."
A pretender, a dog, and a brat?
Fadia narrowed her eyes.
Well then… let's find that "something interesting."

Content.SourceString:
法帝娅·利尔尼亚，她是政治世家的独女、早熟的千金小姐、金丝雀笼里的困兽。
从出生起，她在众人瞩目中所学会的第一件事便是「隐藏欲望」。
直到父母、家庭、所有一切都在那次无意识的暴走之下湮灭……她不再是利尔尼亚，也不需要再是。
于是，她给自己取了一个新名字——法帝娅·DD，代表着「欲望与死亡」。
Content.LocalizedString:
Fadia Lirnia was the only daughter of a political family, a precocious rich girl, a bird caged behind golden bars.
From birth, the first thing she learned under everyone's watchful eyes was to hide her desires.
Until her parents, family, everything was destroyed in that unconscious rampage… She was no longer a Lirnia, and didn't need to be.
So… she gave herself a new name: Fadia DD. Desire and Death.

Content.SourceString:
无尽的新生与轮回，终归于黑洞般的虚无。
生命遵循螺旋线式的轨迹，不偏不倚，一圈一圈向内收束，最后会抵达……古神的乐园吗？
嘘。好孩子，不必细想。
Content.LocalizedString:
Endless rebirth and reincarnation all lead to the black hole of nothingness.
Life follows a spiral path, perfectly balanced, circling inward ring by ring, until it finally reaches… the ancient gods' paradise?
Shh. Good child, don't think too hard about it.

Content.SourceString:
法帝娅无师自通地学会了操纵疼痛，就和应付那群满脑子钱权的蠢人一样自如。
抓伤自己，再把疼痛分散到身体各处，追求某种均衡——力度控制得正好。在这之中，她找到一种令人上瘾的「平静」。
大部分人因为缺少情感连接的能力，转而将自己投入其他容易「专注并成瘾」的事物。极致的痛苦与快乐交替而行，这正是令人欲罢不能的秘诀。
她怜悯那些人，就像怜悯自己一样。
「可怜的孩子们，欲望是他们唯一值得依靠的东西。去发泄、哭泣、沉沦、索取吧，像婴儿渴求母亲的奶水一般。」
Content.LocalizedString:
Fadia taught herself to manipulate pain as easily as dealing with those money and power-obsessed fools.
She scratches herself, then spreads the pain throughout her body, seeking some kind of balance… the force controlled just right. In this, she has found an addictive calm.
Most people lack the ability to connect emotionally, throwing themselves into things that are easy to focus on and get addicted to. Alternating between extreme pain and pleasure… that's the secret that makes it impossible to stop.
She pities those people, just like she pities herself.
"Poor children, desire is the only thing they can rely on. Go ahead, vent, cry, succumb. Take what you desire, like babies craving their mother's milk."

Content.SourceString:
人类的生存总有多种对立矛盾，譬如：禁忌与僭越、生殖与死亡、杀人与献祭、神圣与渎圣。
在这个无序的、卑俗的物质主义世界中，唯有「爱欲」接纳人们的一切——一切忘我的、丑陋的、愚蠢的、欢愉的面庞。
牵起她的手吧，拥入她的怀抱。
去感受那无谓骄傲的外表之下，藏着怎样感激涕零的虔诚……
去感受虔诚之中，蠕动着怎样无止尽的、瘙痒般的欲望。
Content.LocalizedString:
Human survival is contradictory. For example: taboo and transgression, reproduction and death, murder and sacrifice, sacred and profane.
In this chaotic, vulgar materialist world, only lust accepts everything about people. It embraces all their selfless, ugly, stupid, joyful faces.
Take her hand, embrace her.
Feel what grateful devotion hides behind that meaningless proud facade…
Feel how the endless, itching desire writhes within that devotion.

Content.SourceString:
一只「知更鸟」，无言地盯着某处。
十二岁的女孩望着鸟儿胸前橙红色的羽翼出了神，循着脚下的岔路第一次偏离了「原有的轨道」。
后来，她在疼痛而模糊的意识中再次见到它。
挣扎着，费力地向前伸手。
只触到一丝羽梢也好……
「知更鸟」，无言地盯着某处。
Content.LocalizedString:
A robin, silently staring into the distance.
The twelve-year-old girl, mesmerized by the orange-red feathers on the bird's chest, followed the fork in the path and straying off course for the first time.
Later, she saw it again in her painful, hazy consciousness.
Struggling, reaching forward with such painstaking effort…
If only she could touch but a single feather tip…
A robin, silently staring into the distance.

Content.SourceString: 法帝娅。如你所见，目前在这个满是条条框框的地方接受「禁制」。直觉告诉我，未来我们会常见面呢。第一次要是没记住我，下回可就要接受惩罚了……
Content.LocalizedString: Fadia here. As you can see, I'm currently under… probation… in this place full of rules and regulations. My intuition tells me we'll be seeing a lot of each other. Better remember me from now, or you will know…

Content.SourceString: 任务？寻访调查？……可喜可贺，这么下去，E.T.D很快就能并入居民委员会了。
Content.LocalizedString: Missions? Investigations? …How delightful. ETD might as well work under the resident association.

Content.SourceString: 这些庸常的皮囊下，究竟藏着怎样的欲望呢？
Content.LocalizedString: I wonder what desires lurk beneath these mundane shells?

Content.SourceString: 呵，「白蜡树」的草包，每次我都要装作没有发现他们的样子，也是很辛苦的啊。
Content.LocalizedString: Heh, those Fraxinus fools… Having to pretend I don't notice them every time is quite the hassle.

Content.SourceString: 真是刺眼的太阳，像是被灼热的视线盯着……
Content.LocalizedString: What a blinding sun… like being watched with scorching eyes…

Content.SourceString: 平日里像人偶一样循规蹈矩的人因为雨水打在脸上而狼狈不堪，这样的场景真是有趣呢。
Content.LocalizedString: How funny it is to see those usually prim and proper dolls all messed up, with rain dripping down their faces.

Content.SourceString: 无论何时我可都是热火朝天的~
Content.LocalizedString: I'm always fired up and ready to go!

Content.SourceString: 衣服——都黏在身上了。
Content.LocalizedString: My clothes… are sticking to me.

Content.SourceString: 头发和衣服都没整理好，这么想见到我？
Content.LocalizedString: Lookin' so messy, so eager to see me?

Content.SourceString: 不请我喝一杯么？……正因为是中午，才要找些乐子打起精神呀。
Content.LocalizedString: Care to buy me a drink? What better way to liven up the afternoon than with a little fun?

Content.SourceString: 既然天要黑了，不如去些适合晚上去的地方？
Content.LocalizedString: Since night's falling, why don't we go somewhere better suited for the dark?

Content.SourceString: 夜晚才刚刚开始，这就要说晚安了？
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, the night's still young, sleepy head.

Content.SourceString: 一切能让我感到愉悦的事情——我都喜欢。
Content.LocalizedString: As long as it brings pleasure, I like it.

Content.SourceString: 要是没有翳那只看门狗每次死盯着我，我可是会在任务里玩得更尽兴呢。
Content.LocalizedString: If it wasn't for that watchdog, I'd be having way more fun in my missions.

Content.SourceString: 赤裸地、面对面地凝视那东西，在和死亡一样美丽的天空中，向着无限的空虚敞开自身的一切——即便是立刻在这空虚中被撕裂、耗尽，坠落，又能有什么怨言呢？
Content.LocalizedString: Gazing face-to-face, beneath skies as beautiful as death itself… Opening everything to the infinite void, even if it means being torn apart, consumed, and cast down into that emptiness right here and now… How could anyone complain?

Content.SourceString: 你也与那地方关系匪浅，那你说，那地方究竟是绝望卑贱的囚笼，还是迷狂神圣的乐园呢？
Content.LocalizedString: You're no stranger to that place too, aren't you? So tell me—is it a wretched prison of despair, or a sacred paradise of madness?

Content.SourceString:
人与人的存在之间横亘着一道深渊，而欲望才是摧毁这种封闭的最好手段。死亡在我们之间投射下恐惧和诱惑的鬼影，你听，是它们在窃窃私语，引诱着我们一再铤而走险。
欲壑难平，永不满足——这是你我，更是所有人类的痼疾。那么此刻的你究竟压抑着怎样的欲望呢？稍微显露出来一些吧，没关系的~
Content.LocalizedString:
An abyss lies between all human existence, and desire is the perfect tool to shatter such isolation. Death casts shadows of fear and temptation between us—listen closely to their whispers, luring us to take risk after risk.
The pit of desire can never be filled, never satisfied—this affliction plagues not just you and me, but all of humanity. So tell me, what desires are you suppressing right now? Go on, show me… just a bit.

Content.SourceString: 对于短暂而易朽的肉体来说，疼痛是最好的饲料。它活着，它兴旺，它让人在目眩神迷的残酷和战栗中无限接近于死亡。
Content.LocalizedString: For this frail, decaying flesh of ours, pain is the finest feast. It lives, it thrives, and in our dizzying cruelty and trembling, it brings us ever closer to death.

Content.SourceString: 既然是「迷恋」，又怎么能够要求他们适可而止呢~
Content.LocalizedString: Well, there's no restraining their obsession!

Content.SourceString: 猎人的耐心可是有些危险的信号，好的猎人只会为猎物付出全部的耐心，就像……我对你这样——呵呵，是玩笑哦~
Content.LocalizedString: Patience from a hunter can be quite the dangerous sign… Good hunters only invest their patience in hunting… just like I do with you—Tsk tsk, got you there.

Content.SourceString: 总是摆出一幅吊儿郎当的模样，那家伙，骨子里可是个十足的圣人。
Content.LocalizedString: Always acting like a slacker, but that guy… deep down he's a true saint.

Content.SourceString: 那个像蛇一样的女人，不惜从格赫罗斯岛捞出危险的异能者为己用，究竟在想些什么呢？说不定，她也不比格赫罗斯岛里那些怪物安全多少，谁知道呢~
Content.LocalizedString: What's that snake of a woman thinking, fishing out dangerous Espers from Ghroth Island for her own use? For all we know, she might be just as dangerous as the monsters on that island.

Content.SourceString: 不想听他啰嗦的时候，只需一点「小手段」转移他的注意力就好了。比起顾及自身的想法和情绪，那只死狗总是会优先考虑控制局面。
Content.LocalizedString: When I don't want to hear him ramble, a little… trick… should just divert his attention enough. That dog prioritizes controlling the situation over his own thoughts and feelings.

Content.SourceString: 什么事都不放在心上，还真是轻松呢……在能够天真的时候就尽情天真吧，可爱的，可爱的小弥撒。
Content.LocalizedString: Not having a care in the world must be nice… Stay innocent while you can, my sweet little Mosa.

Content.SourceString: 某种程度上，我可并不讨厌这地方。跟那座无序的坟墓相比，这里所谓坚不可摧的理性，只是将一切僭越和禁忌都以崇高的名义合理化了而已。
Content.LocalizedString: To some extent, I don't really hate this place. Compared to that chaotic grave, the so-called unshakeable rationality here merely legitimizes all transgressions and taboos under noble pretenses and facades.

Content.SourceString: 一面朝向可被确定、可被理解的世界，另一面则是被否定的、被诅咒的那部分——那女人组建四队的用意，或许就是以此为据呢。
Content.LocalizedString: One side faces a world that can be defined and understood, while the other faces what's denied and cursed—perhaps that's why she brought us together in the ETD-4.
This… this pain!

Content.SourceString: 看到了……我……
Content.LocalizedString: I can see… I…

Content.SourceString: 不顾形象地向上攀附，哈，你在索求什么？
Content.LocalizedString: Clawing your way up without dignity…? Heh, what are you after?

Content.SourceString: 其实，和礼物一样珍贵的……是你♥
Content.LocalizedString: What's more precious than the gift… is you! ♥

Content.SourceString: 是因为你也喜欢它，才想着送给我的吗？真可爱。
Content.LocalizedString: Did you give it to me because you liked it? How adorable.

Content.SourceString: 礼物是感情的具象化。所以你……？
Content.LocalizedString: Gifts symbolize affection. That means you…

Content.SourceString: 我就收下了。你对我的——爱~
Content.LocalizedString: Your L-O-V-E for me. I'll take it.

Content.SourceString: 想要更多吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Want some more?

Content.SourceString: 要习惯哦~
Content.LocalizedString: Better get used to it.

Content.SourceString: 乖孩子。
Content.LocalizedString: Attaboy.

Content.SourceString: 我来引导你~
Content.LocalizedString: I'll guide you.

Content.SourceString: 痛苦，是亲密的见证。
Content.LocalizedString: Intimacy through pain.

Content.SourceString: 你的期待，我来回应~
Content.LocalizedString: Feeling satisfied?

Content.SourceString: 异象也能感受到「爱」么？
Content.LocalizedString: Can anomalies feel love?

Content.SourceString: 或许是一次「赎罪」的机会~
Content.LocalizedString: Perhaps a chance for redemption…?

Content.SourceString: 下次，可要多给我一些惊喜~
Content.LocalizedString: Give me a show next time.

Content.SourceString: 疼吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Does it hurt?

Content.SourceString: 只有这些无聊的东西么？
Content.LocalizedString: Is that all you've got?

Content.SourceString: 看起来我得自己去创造些乐子了。
Content.LocalizedString: Looks like I'll have to make my own fun.

Content.SourceString: 想讨好我，可没有这么简单~
Content.LocalizedString: I'm not so easily won over.

Content.SourceString: 马马虎虎。
Content.LocalizedString: Mediocre.

Content.SourceString: 可以填补某些空缺的小玩意儿。
Content.LocalizedString: A little something to fill the gaps.

Content.SourceString: 谁把它给忘了？真可怜。
Content.LocalizedString: Who left it behind? How pitiful.

Content.SourceString: 再痛一些，也没关系~
Content.LocalizedString: A little pain won't hurt!

Content.SourceString: 对，这才叫「活着」！
Content.LocalizedString: This… is being alive!

Content.SourceString: 生命……破破烂烂地燃烧才好！
Content.LocalizedString: Life… is better when it's blazing to ashes!

Content.SourceString: 是在担心我么？
Content.LocalizedString: Aren't you worried about me?

Content.SourceString: 痛楚的美味，还没品尝够呢~
Content.LocalizedString: Haven't had my fill of this agony yet…

Content.SourceString: 还真是激烈的「爱」啊……
Content.LocalizedString: Such a violent display of love…

Content.SourceString: 哈哈哈哈，这就是……
Content.LocalizedString: Haa, so this is…

Content.SourceString: 这瞬间……无法持续啊……
Content.LocalizedString: This moment… it's slipping away…

Content.SourceString: 脆弱的猎物。
Content.LocalizedString: So fragile.

Content.SourceString: 这就坏掉了？
Content.LocalizedString: Broken already?

Content.SourceString: 用力一点。
Content.LocalizedString: Harder.

Content.SourceString: 有些失望呢。
Content.LocalizedString: How disappointing.

Content.SourceString: 没错，就是这样！
Content.LocalizedString: That's right!

Content.SourceString: 我很中意。
Content.LocalizedString: I love it!

Content.SourceString: 去蹂躏那些家伙吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Bring them to their knees.

Content.SourceString: 太弱的我可没有兴趣。
Content.LocalizedString: I have no interest in weaklings.

Content.SourceString: 别碍事噢~
Content.LocalizedString: Don't get in my way!

Content.SourceString: 完美的舞台。
Content.LocalizedString: The perfect stage.

Content.SourceString: 在等我吗~
Content.LocalizedString: Waiting for me?

Content.SourceString: 落地前，就这么歇一会儿吧~
Content.LocalizedString: Let's take a breather before we land.

Content.SourceString: 拉伸有助缓解肌肉酸痛~
Content.LocalizedString: Stretching helps relieve sore muscles.

Content.SourceString: 早该到我了。
Content.LocalizedString: It's about time.

Content.SourceString: 宝贝，游戏开始咯~
Content.LocalizedString: Cutie, let the games begin.

Content.SourceString: 想要我从哪里开始疼爱？
Content.LocalizedString: Where would you like me to start hurting you?

Content.SourceString: 打得不够痛快呢~
Content.LocalizedString: That wasn't nearly satisfying.

Content.SourceString: 这么快就轮班，是你也不意外了~
Content.LocalizedString: That was fast. Can't say I'm surprised.

Content.SourceString: 释放——这是我擅长的事。
Content.LocalizedString: Releasing… that's what I do best.

Content.SourceString: 美味还需趁热享用。
Content.LocalizedString: The best treats should be enjoyed while they're warm.

Content.SourceString: 保护动物，人人有责。
Content.LocalizedString: Everyone should protect animals.

Content.SourceString: 又要偷懒去了？
Content.LocalizedString: Slacking off again?

Content.SourceString: 小弥撒，先躲一会儿吧~
Content.LocalizedString: Mosa, hide for a bit.

Content.SourceString: 提醒一下，小猫都有九条命哦。
Content.LocalizedString: Just a reminder… cats have nine lives.

Content.SourceString: 欲望不够！
Content.LocalizedString: Not enough desire!

Content.SourceString: 无趣。
Content.LocalizedString: Boring.

Content.SourceString: 瞧你，又急。
Content.LocalizedString: Look at you, always in a rush.

Content.SourceString: 一味进攻……乱了手脚呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Just charging forward… losing your pace.
